question: What is the name of the Indian Army research cell launched at IIT Madras?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Agnishodh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Army, IIT Madras Launch 'Agnishodh' to Boost Defence Innovation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Indian Army** and **IIT Madras** have set up **‘Agnishodh’**, the **Indian Army Research Cell (IARC)**.

 
 
• 
 
Located on the **IIT Madras campus**, part of the Army’s **Five Pillars of Transformation** strategy.

 
 
• 
 
**Agnishodh** focuses on **Modernisation and Technology Infusion**, one of the five pillars.

 
 
• 
 
It aims to **convert lab innovations into deployable defence tech** through collaboration with **IIT Madras Research Park** and **AMTDC**.

 
 
• 
 
Areas of research include **additive manufacturing**, **cybersecurity**, **quantum computing**, **wireless communication**, and **UAVs**.

 
 
• 
 
The initiative will also **upskill military personnel** in **emerging technology domains**.

 
 
• 
 
This effort strengthens the link between the **military and academia** to accelerate **indigenous defence solutions**.
